{{Quote|Imperial destroyer Firelance has gone critical. The Republic fleet is holding steady.|Helm Officer [[Martos]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Firelance ''''' was a [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class destroyer]] that was part of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] it participated in the [[Battle of the Foundry]], during which it suffered critical damage.
